encodings.note: Return from handling a user interrupt.

exceptions.when: The UIRET instruction is not recognized in protected mode.
The UIRET instruction is not recognized in real-address mode.
The UIRET instruction is not recognized in virtual-8086 mode.
The UIRET instruction is not recognized in compatibility mode.
If the return instruction pointer is non-canonical.
If an attempt to pop a value off the stack causes a non-canonical address to be referenced. #PF(fault-code) If a page fault occurs.
If alignment checking is enabled and an unaligned memory reference is made while the current privilege level is 3.
If return instruction pointer from stack and shadow stack do not match.
If the LOCK prefix is used. If executed inside an enclave. If CR4.UINTR = 0. If CPUID.07H.00H:EDX.UINTR[5] = 0.
